name: qa_fold
title: OS-INSFX-FX1, the Fold effect module (modules/effects/fold, kind 2) as a track insert from the console: loaded from the card, bound with `diag ins`, heard, its tail ends at once, and its cost read with `diag bench insert` (bench image). Console only: the insert is NOT saved (S3), and the console has no insert parameter verb, so the Fold, Symmetry and Tone sweeps are a hand check once the Mixer's INSERTS page and the parameter page exist (S4, S5). Needs modules/effects/fold.tmod on the card (the build's modules/fold.tmod, copied by the tester). Reset the unit first so that fold is the only effect module loaded (`diag bench insert` times the first loaded effect). Writes nothing to the card. Leaves no insert bound

steps.say: OS-INSFX-FX1, rows QA-GLB-201 to 204 of docs/qa/catalogue/global.md (a unit step is named by the row id its note begins with; QA-GLB-202 and 203 are host tests). Put modules/effects/fold.tmod on the card, reset the unit so that no other effect module is loaded, and open the project the run is about (the Dense8 song of OS-DENSE, or any project with a sounding track 1). The insert is console-bound: it is lost on save and on reload until the project record lands (slice S3). The default setting is Fold 9 dB (the signal folds back above -9 dBFS), Symmetry 0, Tone 12 kHz, mix 100 %, output 0 dB: track 1 must sound the same where its peaks stay under -9 dBFS and buzz where they pass it, at the same level as the bypassed track or lower (`ins bypass 1 1 on` and `off` to compare), never louder

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
QA-GLB-201: the packed module passes the loader on the unit
QA-GLB-201: loaded, version 1.0.0; `mod` also says where its hot part runs (the SRAM_L slab or SDRAM): read it against the hot size of the build
QA-GLB-201: bound to track 1, slot 1, with its default parameters
QA-GLB-201: the insert runs (phase on) and its measured cycles and share of the block are on the line (the figure the spec estimates at 0.7 % [est] (about 1.9k cycles a block settled))
QA-GLB-201: the load with the insert on; underruns 0; read it against the same project with no insert
QA-GLB-201: nothing was forced to dry

steps.say: QA-GLB-201, by ear: track 1 is the same sound where its peaks are quiet (under -9 dBFS) and folded where they are loud (a buzzy, hollowed attack: a loud sample's peaks reflect back, so the loud parts get a little quieter and brighter), and its LEVEL IS THE SAME as bypassed or LOWER, never higher (the check DRIVE failed at its defaults: compare with `ins bypass 1 1 on`, and look for a hotter or clipped stem); the other tracks are unchanged. Then `ins bypass 1 1 on`: the clean sound returns with no click

steps.note: QA-GLB-201: bypass is the host's one-block ramp to dry
QA-GLB-201: off resets the module (shutdown, init) and the effect starts from silence: no thump

QA-GLB-201: a second and a half after the stop there is no `tail` word: the fold's filters ring a few thousand samples (a few tens of ms at the 12 kHz tone) and the module returns 0 once they are under -140 dB
QA-GLB-201: the render figure is a stopped transport's, with the fold bound and idle

expect: BENCH insert \d+ 64 avg \d+ max \d+ \(.*, adapter \d+ cycles \(\d+\.\d%\) peak \d+\)
steps.note: QA-GLB-204: bench image (`-DO3OS_BENCH=ON`), transport stopped, fold the only loaded effect: `insert_effect` is the settled render() of 64 frames at the defaults, `insert_effect_mod` the same with set_param on Fold, the first MOD target, every block (a sweep: the derivation's four exp2, the worst case), `insert` the whole insert with the adapter. Quote min, avg and max in cycles and as a share of the 261,225-cycle block against the budget (docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 FOLD rows)

steps.say: QA-GLB-204: copy the four BENCH lines (min / avg / max) into docs/architecture/cpu-budget.md, the OS-INSFX-FX1 FOLD rows, and into the module's README; the cap of four instances stays or is lowered from them (spec section 6)
